    X = pd.get_dummies(d['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[c] = d[c]
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'], X).fit()

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

print(df.groupby('lab')[cands+['tensile_mpa']].mean().round(3))

d = df.dropna().copy()

m = sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'], X).fit()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# per-lab cool_rate effect
for lab, g in df.groupby('lab'):
    d=g.dropna(subset=['cool_rate','tensile_mpa'])
    X=sm.add_constant(d[['cool_rate']])
    m=sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'],X).fit()
    print(lab, f"n={len(d)} coef={m.params['cool_rate']:+.3f} p={m.pvalues['cool_rate']:.3f}")
# add quadratic
d=df.dropna(subset=['cool_rate','tensile_mpa']).copy()
X=pd.get_dummies(d['lab'],drop_first=True).astype(float)
X['cool_rate']=d['cool_rate']; X['cr2']=d['cool_rate']**2
X=sm.add_constant(X)
m=sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'],X).fit()
print("quad:", m.params['cool_rate'], m.pvalues['cool_rate'], m.pvalues['cr2'])
# distribution of cool_rate
print(df['cool_rate'].describe())
